answer: The echo schedule is applied in harbor and walnut shows each instalment. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and hence 22% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4639 identities would post 4531 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
